sections.title: Form and leaves
sections.text: Prunus maximowiczii, Miyama cherry, is a small tree that can reach about 7 m. Its leaves are about 3–9 × 1.5–4 cm.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: White flowers grow in clusters. The rounded fruits are about 5 mm across, red at first and later black. The plate shows the flowers and dark fruit; the large leaf-like bracts described in Flora of China are not clearly shown.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: Some horticultural sources report the fruit as edible and the flowers as traditionally salted for use as a condiment; these uses are less firmly documented than the botanical description.
